Sat, 10 Oct 2026 04:35:59 +0000 en-US hourly 1 https://wordpress.org/?v=7.1.3 https://beesayatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/cropped-09-32x32.png News – beesayatv https://beesayatv.com/ 32 32 PAGASA Declares End of Habagat Season; Cebu Outdoor Enthusiasts Advised to Remain Weather-Aware https://beesayatv.com/pagasa-declares-end-of-habagat-season-cebu-outdoor-enthusiasts-advised-to-remain-weather-aware/ Sat, 10 Oct 2026 04:35:59 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1957

The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) officially declared the end of the southwest monsoon, locally known as Habagat, on October 5, marking the end of the rainy season in the western sections of Luzon and the Visayas. The declaration followed a gradual shift in weather patterns, weakening southwest monsoon winds, and a decrease in associated rainfall.

The end of Habagat does not mean that rain will immediately stop across Cebu. Localized thunderstorms, other weather systems, and tropical cyclones can still bring rainfall. The country is also expected to transition toward the northeast monsoon, or Amihan, which PAGASA will declare when conditions warrant.

For hikers and outdoor enthusiasts in Cebu, the seasonal change may bring opportunities to explore mountain trails, waterfalls, and other natural destinations. However, trail conditions can vary depending on recent rainfall. Slippery paths, muddy slopes, and strong water currents may remain hazards even after several days of fair weather. Outdoor visitors are encouraged to check official forecasts and assess local conditions before traveling to remote areas.

]]> Four Family Members Buried in Cebu City Landslide https://beesayatv.com/four-family-members-buried-in-cebu-city-landslide/ Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:40:04 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1950

Four members of a family, including two young children, were buried in a landslide at Sitio Kandsrong Riverside, Barangay Pulangbato, Cebu City, on October 9, 2026. Continuous rainfall and unstable ground hampered rescue operations, according to reports.

The incident highlights the dangers of landslides in communities located near slopes, especially during periods of prolonged rain. Saturated soil can become unstable, increasing the risk of sudden slope failures that threaten lives and property.

The incident also serves as a reminder for hikers and outdoor enthusiasts to exercise caution when visiting Cebu’s mountains and trails during rainy weather. Avoid steep slopes and landslide-prone areas, monitor official weather advisories, and postpone outdoor activities when conditions become hazardous.

Source: https://www.sunstar.com.ph/cebu/4-family-members-buried-in-cebu-city-landslide

]]> PAGASA warns of thunderstorms, flash floods and landslides across Cebu https://beesayatv.com/pagasa-warns-of-thunderstorms-flash-floods-and-landslides-across-cebu/ Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:49:46 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1941

PAGASA is warning of thunderstorms and periods of heavy rain across Cebu, with the weather conditions capable of triggering flash floods and landslides in vulnerable areas.

The advisories cover several parts of Cebu as thunderstorms continue to develop across the province. Heavy rainfall may cause sudden rises in water levels, particularly in rivers and streams in mountainous areas.

For hikers and outdoor visitors, the conditions could affect trails, waterfalls and mountain access roads. River crossings may become hazardous, while saturated slopes can become more susceptible to landslides and falling debris.

Outdoor trips may therefore require extra caution, particularly on routes that pass through steep terrain, streams or areas with a history of flooding and landslides.

PAGASA advises the public to monitor the latest weather updates as conditions can change quickly during periods of thunderstorms.

Source: Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA)

]]> Ultra Trail Alegria 2026 Set for November https://beesayatv.com/ultra-trail-alegria-2026-set-for-november/ Wed, 07 Oct 2026 05:51:54 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1900

Trail runners will head to Alegria, Cebu on November 28–29, 2026, for the M4M Ultra Trail Alegria 2026, a two-day trail running event organized by Bakyard.

The event features four race categories: 50K, 30K, 15K, and 8K, with courses taking runners through the mountainous landscape around Mt. Lanaya and surrounding communities.

The longest course covers more than 55 kilometers with approximately 1,900 meters of elevation gain, while the 15K and 8K routes offer shorter options through the same rugged South Cebu landscape.

The event is part of the Miles for Minds initiative, with the organizers highlighting mental-health advocacy through the race.

]]> 775 Trees Planted in Mt. Manunggal Forest Restoration Effort https://beesayatv.com/775-trees-planted-in-mt-manunggal-forest-restoration-effort/ Thu, 01 Oct 2026 23:37:01 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1866

More than 30 government agencies and partner organizations planted 775 trees and bamboo across two hectares in Barangay Sunog, Balamban, as part of a forest restoration effort in Mt. Manunggal.

The planting area is within the Central Cebu Protected Landscape, a protected area that contains important forest ecosystems and watersheds in Cebu. The species planted included indigenous forest trees, fruit trees and bamboo.

According to DENR Region 7, the activity aims to restore forest cover, support biodiversity and strengthen the ecological functions of the protected landscape.

For hikers, forest restoration in Mt. Manunggal can help protect the natural environment surrounding the trails. Healthy forests provide habitat for wildlife, help regulate water flow and support the streams and other water sources found in Cebu’s mountain areas.

Hikers visiting Mt. Manunggal and other parts of the Central Cebu Protected Landscape should stay on established trails, avoid damaging young trees and vegetation, and leave natural areas undisturbed as restoration efforts continue.

Source: DENR Region 7
Published: September 30, 2026

]]> El Niño Intensifies: What Hikers Should Prepare For https://beesayatv.com/el-nino-intensifies-what-hikers-should-prepare-for/ Wed, 30 Sep 2026 23:40:17 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1759

The Climate Change Commission (CCC) is urging government agencies, schools and communities to strengthen preparations for El Niño as dry conditions are expected to intensify across the Philippines.

The advisory follows PAGASA’s warning that the current strong El Niño could develop into a very strong event between September and December 2026 and persist through the first half of 2027.

PAGASA said El Niño generally brings warmer temperatures and below-normal rainfall, increasing the risk of prolonged dry spells, drought and pressure on water resources. Short periods of heavy rainfall may still occur because of the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones.

For hikers, prolonged dry conditions may mean hotter trails, reduced water flow in rivers and waterfalls, drier vegetation and fewer reliable natural water sources.

Hikers should carry more drinking water than usual, start early to avoid the hottest part of the day, check PAGASA and local advisories before leaving, and avoid relying on streams or springs that may normally provide water. Extra caution is also advisable in dry grasslands and forest areas where fire risk may increase.

]]> DENR Closes Spartan Trail in Cebu Until Further Notice https://beesayatv.com/denr-closes-spartan-trail-in-cebu-until-further-notice/ Mon, 21 Sep 2026 11:57:28 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1649

The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has officially closed the Spartan Trail within the Central Cebu Protected Landscape until further notice.

Issued on September 21, 2026, the closure order allows authorities to investigate reported environmental violations and carry out necessary rehabilitation work in the area. Under Republic Act 9486 and Republic Act 11038, all entry, hiking, trekking, and recreational activities are strictly prohibited. Only authorized personnel involved in enforcement, monitoring, and rehabilitation are permitted to enter.

Hikers and visitors are advised to consider the Spartan Trail completely off-limits, avoid alternative entry points, and wait for an official reopening notice from authorities before planning future trips.

]]> El Niño Is Strengthening — What It Could Mean for Cebu’s Mountains and Trails https://beesayatv.com/el-nino-is-strengthening-what-it-could-mean-for-cebus-mountains-and-trails/ Sat, 19 Sep 2026 23:26:43 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1644

A strong El Niño is currently established across the tropical Pacific and is projected to intensify further over the coming months.

According to PAGASA and the World Meteorological Organization, moderate to strong conditions are expected to reach very strong intensity by late 2026, with a high likelihood of persisting into early 2027.

For Cebu and the broader Philippines, this climate event typically triggers below-normal rainfall, dry spells, and potential drought, though localized rain and Habagat showers remain possible.

Hikers and local residents in Cebu’s uplands should anticipate hotter and drier trail conditions, drying vegetation, and reduced water levels in mountain streams as the dry conditions progress.
